category: usenet provider (Dutch, speed-tiered flats and non-expiring blocks)

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial; a 7-day money-back guarantee is the only risk reversal on the plans.

retention.stated: 3800 days of binary retention on every plan and block

egress.terms: Unlimited download on the three flat plans; blocks of 500, 1000 and 2500 GB that never expire

chaining: Blocks of 500, 1000 and 2500 GB at 1000 Mbit/s never expire, so a one-time block is the bulk route; the flats are speed-tiered.

limits.value: 20 Mbit/s on Starter, 100 Mbit/s on Fast, 1000 Mbit/s on Lightspeed
10 connections on Starter, 40 on Fast, 60 on Lightspeed
blocks of 500, 1000 and 2500 GB with no expiry

limits_note: Flats per month: Starter EUR 1.69, Fast EUR 2.89, Lightspeed EUR 3.39. Blocks one-time: 500 GB EUR 9.99, 1000 GB EUR 15.99, 2500 GB EUR 35.99. The page does not say which billing period the monthly prices assume.
binding_note: The flats are unlimited in volume, so speed and connection count bound a month; the blocks are bounded by GB.
